summary: Verified backend health, unauthenticated authorization boundaries, invalid OAuth session rejection, and the public mobile Expo login/OAuth flow.
action_items: Align the frontend environment contract with the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL name, or explicitly document EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL as the supported key; current code does not read EXPO_BACKEND_URL.
Provide a Google OAuth test account to verify authenticated dashboard, drawer navigation, and RBAC flows.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly fails fast for MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, and JWT_SECRET via os.environ indexing.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while the review requirement names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; this is a deployment/configuration contract mismatch unless intentional.
Akses / User and Pengaturan remain placeholder destinations, consistent with the prior non-blocking backlog.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No Google test account exists in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Public mobile preview loaded and OAuth redirected to Google without a crash. Authenticated flows remain unverified.
rca_of_issue: GET /api/health returned 200; protected endpoints without Bearer tokens returned 401; fabricated POST /api/auth/session returned 401. The login button with data-testid google-login-button redirected to accounts.google.com successfully. The browser script's final error scan had a malformed JavaScript selector, which is a test-script issue only and occurred after all assertions passed.
